mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies around the Badger Prairie County Park area. Tonight is a full moon, and we have a fantastic viewing opportunity for the International Space Station. It will rise in the northwest near Verona High School at 7:44 PM and travel high across the sky toward the southeast near Festival Foods over a five minute window.

The Planning Department is alerting applicants to be cautious of scams asking for wire transfers or online payments for fees, as the city only accepts checks by mail or hand delivery to City Hall. Additionally, Public Works is gearing up for fall leaf pickup starting October 5th.
It is a busy couple of days for our community with Verona Fall Fest happening today at Hometown USA Festival Park, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square tomorrow.
Looking at the records, on September 3rd, a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's is closed today as the team works on a store remodel to better serve our community.
